review.gallery: One dated developer progress photograph and eight original brochure renders. The construction image leads the gallery and listing card.
review.location: The developer map marks the canal site and gives twelve launch estimates. Benham and Reeves corroborates the approximate Mitchell’s point. The La Mer entry is a launch-map area estimate.
review.floorPlans: Ten complete drawings from direct developer PDFs. The Type A two-bedroom components total 1,420.40 sq ft against 1,420.41 printed. The 10,004 sq ft penthouse appears as a type in the developer brief and slim brochure. No matching drawing was identified in the public developer and portal plan packs.

unavailable: A verified five-bedroom penthouse floor plan, separate podium drawings, surveyed visitor entrance and completed project photography.
